correctness.rationale: For a connected dominating five-set the induced edge count must be four, since at least 11 outside vertices need a boundary edge and the cube has degree four. Each length-two tree path produces an outside common neighbor of the endpoints: their only other common neighbor is the middle vertex, and a second inside would give a four-cycle in the induced tree. At least three such paths cannot be accounted for by 12 boundary incidences on 11 vertices (only one outside vertex could have a pair of neighbors, and it could have just two). Smaller connected dominating sets can be enlarged, and the stated six-path dominates. Independent exact replay (python3 -B /workspace/branches/independent_replay.py 2) used Hamming adjacency and traversals on all subsets of sizes 1--6, verified all 11 stated orbit rows against independently chosen representatives, and generated exchanges via common five-subset buckets. It found all 192 optimizers equal to the flip-word family, 1,952 connected six-sets, and the frozen shell vector at every optimum. The common shells imply connectivity, degree four, diameter seven and the unordered-pair histogram. Attaching all vertices outside any minimum backbone as leaves gives a spanning tree, whose internal set must be the entire backbone by the established minimum; conversely a spanning tree's internal vertices dominate and are connected.

value.rationale: The minimum-layer exchange geometry is a naturally motivated finite invariant, but this submission primarily recomputes the already exact classification and metric. Its extra certificate for connected six-subsets tabulates the search space used to derive a conclusion already known; the frozen record does not motivate a separate scientific use of that census as a new claim, and its mere verification does not rescue the contribution. No substantive narrowed replacement is being delivered.
